method: Frozen shared evaluator v1 results (official queue, exact-request recoveries, Codex retry file, Claude harness replay of Codex compression_escape). Net R after realistic costs; stress doubles spreads/slippage. Trade-level bootstrap CI and sign-flip p per cell; Holm across 87 instrument cells on the test split. Variants with overlapping entries are treated as one hypothesis. All historical splits were previously exposed; none is an untouched holdout.
category_A_note: No strategy has positive out-of-sample evidence that survives multiple-testing correction. Category A is empty; no strategy is promoted.
